newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange rises on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange rises on Monday.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange rose again on Monday, buoyed by Kumasi Brewery Ltd, which was 80 cedis at 800 cedis.
The Ghana All-Share index rose 0.58 points to 367.80 from 367.22 on Friday.
A total of 61,440 shares were traded, with bids outstripping offers 5,474,240 to 404,860.
The other risers were Super Paper Products Co, up five to 100, Unilever, up four at 842 and Enterprise Insurance Co, which rose eight to 494.
